description: CRITICAL, blocks everything else. Port the web AI layer from Anthropic to DeepSeek using the official `openai` npm package (DeepSeek is OpenAI-API-compatible), preserving all exported signatures, call sites, and system prompts verbatim. Also fix the test GAP: there is no jest config and no `npm test` script today, so the required security tests cannot run — add both. Independent of FEAT-002/003 at the code level, but must come first because the Outreach/CRM demo moments depend on these AI helpers compiling and the test suite being runnable.
steps: Add `openai` to dependencies in /Users/leeguanfeng/Documents/Github/Assura/.worktrees/jeff-outreach-crm/web/package.json and remove `@anthropic-ai/sdk` (grep confirmed only ai.ts and quarantine.ts use it in web/). Run `npm install` from the web/ dir to resolve openai and update package-lock.json.

Rewrite the internals of /Users/leeguanfeng/Documents/Github/Assura/.worktrees/jeff-outreach-crm/web/src/lib/ai.ts: replace `import Anthropic` and `new Anthropic()` with `import OpenAI from "openai"` and `new OpenAI({ baseURL: "https://api.deepseek.com", apiKey: process.env.DEEPSEEK_API_KEY })`. chatWithPlans: use client.chat.completions.create({ model: "deepseek-chat", messages, stream: true, max_tokens: 1024 }); move the existing system prompt into a leading { role: "system", content } message; `for await (const chunk of stream) { const delta = chunk.choices[0]?.delta?.content; if (delta) yield delta; }`; keep it AsyncGenerator<string>. draftOutreachEmail: const res = await client.chat.completions.create({ model: "deepseek-chat", messages, max_tokens: 600 }); return res.choices[0]?.message?.content ?? ""; keep the Promise<string> signature and all the consent/sharedDetails logic unchanged. Keep FACTUAL_GUARDRAIL and AI_DISCLOSURE_PREFIX text verbatim. Leave extractQuoteFromThread as-is (it delegates to quarantine.ts).

Rewrite the internals of /Users/leeguanfeng/Documents/Github/Assura/.worktrees/jeff-outreach-crm/web/src/lib/quarantine.ts: swap the client to OpenAI as above; parseUntrustedText uses client.chat.completions.create({ model: "deepseek-chat", max_tokens: 1024, response_format: { type: "json_object" }, messages: [{ role: "system", content: QUARANTINE_SYSTEM_PROMPT }, { role: "user", content: <existing user content> }] }); read the text from res.choices[0]?.message?.content ?? ""; keep the existing JSON.parse(raw.trim()) try/catch, the Zod safeParse guard, and the EXACT existing thrown-error message strings. Keep QUARANTINE_SYSTEM_PROMPT text verbatim.

Create /Users/leeguanfeng/Documents/Github/Assura/.worktrees/jeff-outreach-crm/web/jest.config.js: CommonJS module.exports with preset 'ts-jest', testEnvironment 'node', testMatch for src/__tests__/**/*.test.ts, setupFilesAfterEach: ['<rootDir>/src/__tests__/setup.ts'], and moduleNameMapper { '^@/(.*)$': '<rootDir>/src/$1' } so the tests' @/ imports resolve. Exclude setup.ts from being treated as a test.
Add "test": "jest" to the scripts block of /Users/leeguanfeng/Documents/Github/Assura/.worktrees/jeff-outreach-crm/web/package.json.
Update /Users/leeguanfeng/Documents/Github/Assura/.worktrees/jeff-outreach-crm/web/.env.local.example: replace the HERMES_API_KEY section with DEEPSEEK_API_KEY (matches root .env.example).

Record in findings: that scraper/app/scraper/converter.py and scraper/app/config.py still use anthropic (model claude-haiku-4-5-20251001) and need the same port later (Marcus's lane), and note the sendRequestSchema userApproved:true requirement for FEAT-002.
acceptance_criteria: `grep -rn "@anthropic-ai/sdk" /Users/leeguanfeng/Documents/Github/Assura/.worktrees/jeff-outreach-crm/web/src` returns no matches and the dependency is gone from package.json.
No exported function name, signature, or export in ai.ts/quarantine.ts changed; chat/route.ts, outreach/draft/route.ts, and crm/threads/[threadId]/quote/route.ts still compile against them unchanged.
FACTUAL_GUARDRAIL, QUARANTINE_SYSTEM_PROMPT, and AI_DISCLOSURE_PREFIX strings are byte-for-byte unchanged.
`npm test` runs jest and policy.test.ts, audit.test.ts, and blocker.test.ts all pass.
findings:
DONE. Ported web AI layer Anthropic -> DeepSeek via the official `openai` npm package (v6.49.0, range ^6.49.0). ai.ts + quarantine.ts now use new OpenAI({ baseURL: 'https://api.deepseek.com', apiKey: process.env.DEEPSEEK_API_KEY }) with model 'deepseek-chat'. All exported signatures/call sites and the FACTUAL_GUARDRAIL / QUARANTINE_SYSTEM_PROMPT / AI_DISCLOSURE_PREFIX strings are byte-for-byte unchanged (only `system:` param moved into a leading { role:'system' } message per Chat Completions). Added jest.config.js (ts-jest, node env, testMatch src/__tests__/**/*.test.ts, moduleNameMapper @/ -> src/, setupFilesAfterEnv -> setup.ts) and `test`: `jest` script. .env.local.example HERMES_API_KEY -> DEEPSEEK_API_KEY. Verification all green: npm install, npm run build, npm test (12/12 pass across policy/audit/blocker). `npm run lint` passes for the ported files; eslint reports 2 PRE-EXISTING errors in files OUTSIDE this feature's scope (src/app/(public)/page.tsx react/no-unescaped-entities; src/hooks/use-plans.ts react-hooks/set-state-in-effect) — confirmed present on the clean base commit c308127 via git stash, so they are not introduced by this port (they belong to a later UI feature / a separate lint-cleanup lane).

IMPORTANT NOTES FOR LATER STEPS:
(1) The `openai` SDK validates apiKey AT CONSTRUCTION and throws if missing/empty, unlike the old Anthropic client. Since DEEPSEEK_API_KEY is absent in this env and `next build` evaluates route modules, I made the client LAZY in both ai.ts and quarantine.ts (memoized `client()` getter) so module import no longer throws and the build passes keyless. Any future AI helper must follow this same lazy pattern.
(2) TEST INFRA FIX: src/__tests__/setup.ts originally created the temp dir and set process.env.DATA_DIR_OVERRIDE inside beforeAll, but db.ts captures DATA_DIR at import time — with setupFilesAfterEnv the setup body runs before the test module graph loads, so I moved the mkdtemp + DATA_DIR_OVERRIDE assignment to setup.ts module-body (seeding/cleanup stay in beforeAll/afterAll). Without this, 6 tests ENOENT'd against the real ../data dir.
(3) SCRAPER PORT STILL PENDING (Marcus's lane, OUT OF SCOPE here): scraper/app/scraper/converter.py and scraper/app/config.py still use anthropic (model claude-haiku-4-5-20251001) and need the same Anthropic -> DeepSeek port later.
(4) FOR FEAT-002: outreach send path must validate against sendRequestSchema in src/lib/validators.ts, which REQUIRES userApproved:true (human-approval gate before any email send); policy.test.ts already asserts send_email denies unless userApproved=true.
